openNook shows upcoming events in the island so you can glance at the next thing on your calendar.
openNook shows upcoming events in the island and lets you add events from a quick-add line.
openNook shows reminders in the island and lets you mark them complete from there.
openNook shows reminders in the island and lets you add them from a quick-add line.
openNook shows a live camera preview in the Mirror control so you can check yourself before a call.

openNook can use a one-shot city-level location so Weather can show the forecast for where you are. Location is optional — you can enter a city instead. The grant is tied to this build's signature and resets after an ad-hoc re-sign.
openNook can use a one-shot city-level location so Weather can show the forecast for where you are. Location is optional — you can enter a city instead.

openNook uses Automation to pause or skip Music, Spotify, and Safari if system media controls are unavailable, to read the current Safari or Chrome tab URL so the island can show a YouTube thumbnail or site icon when the browser does not provide artwork, and to send iMessage replies from the island.

openNook uses Automation to pause or skip Music, Spotify, and Safari if system media controls are unavailable, and to read the current Safari or Chrome tab URL so the island can show a YouTube thumbnail or site icon when the browser does not provide artwork.
openNook mirrors island timers into Notification Center so a countdown still fires if the overlay is hidden.
openNook reads and writes notes in the Obsidian vault you choose, which may live in Documents.
openNook reads and writes notes in the Obsidian vault you choose, which may live on the Desktop.
openNook reads and writes notes in the Obsidian vault you choose, which may live in Downloads.

openNook adjusts each app's volume by tapping its audio output. It does not save or send what you hear — it only scales the sound in real time. macOS shows a recording indicator while any per-app slider is below 100%.
openNook finds nearby LocalSend devices on your network so you can send files from the island tray. Nothing is received unless you turn receive on in Settings.
